coverage_note: MVP sample: curated Turing Award timeline entries plus an expandable catalog of major computing awards and paper-recognition programs.

awards.name: ACM A.M. Turing Award
awards.description: Often described as the highest distinction in computer science, honoring lasting technical contributions across the field.

awards.name: ACM Grace Murray Hopper Award
awards.description: Highlights a single recent generation-defining contribution from a young computing professional.

awards.name: ACM Prize in Computing
awards.description: Recognizes early- to mid-career professionals whose work has fundamental impact across computing.

awards.name: Donald E. Knuth Prize
awards.scope: foundational contributions to computer science theory
awards.description: Celebrates landmark achievements in theoretical computer science across a career.

awards.name: Gödel Prize
awards.description: Honors outstanding papers in theoretical computer science with deep long-term influence.

awards.name: IEEE John von Neumann Medal
awards.scope: outstanding achievements in computer-related science and technology
awards.description: Recognizes career-level leadership and impact spanning computing science and engineering.

awards.name: AAAI Classic Paper Award
awards.scope: AI conference papers with lasting impact
awards.description: Revisits AI conference papers whose importance becomes more visible over time.

awards.name: ACM Paris Kanellakis Theory and Practice Award
awards.description: Honors theoretical work with concrete influence on computing practice.

awards.name: ICDE 10-Year Influential Paper Award
awards.description: Surfaces influential data engineering work through a ten-year retrospective lens.

awards.name: IJCAI Research Excellence Award
awards.awarding_body: International Joint Conferences on Artificial Intelligence
awards.scope: career research excellence in artificial intelligence
awards.description: Career award for major contributions to artificial intelligence research.

awards.name: SIGIR Test of Time Award
awards.scope: information retrieval papers with long-term impact
awards.description: Highlights influential information retrieval papers years after publication.

awards.name: VLDB 10-Year Best Paper Award
awards.description: Recognizes database papers whose importance is clear over a ten-year horizon.
